title: Weird gets votes, not arguments
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Weird-word stories have fewer comments per point than other stories.
expect: Comments per point for matching stories divided by comments per point for all stories, across 2006 to 2026: at or below 0.95x supports; at or above 1.05x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matching only.

group_a.label: weird and mysterious words comments per point ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: All stories, comments per point ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: Title matching only: the word list is in scripts/film.py and will miss and mis-match some stories.
Archive scores and comment counts for recent stories are low for all stories, so only ratios against the same months are used.
Associations do not show what causes attention.
